description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/common/acceptance/forms/engine-code-rules.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); ADR-0135 addendum (13) item 4, addendum (17) item 1; tasks P02.49, P01.243). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Lexical constraints only where the header of the form states them; the map, the sets of packages and the args stay with the generation cycle of the engine. Not yet a resource of Platform/forms.datapackage.json: the Architect registers it after P02.49.

fields.name: args
fields.description: One JSON object on one line with exactly the fields of the kind; checked by the existing guard.
